hero.subhead: A bilingual tenant portal, every request tracked whichever way it arrives, and Texas compliance built in.
hero.imageAlt: The Rentio tenant portal in Spanish on a phone, showing the balance due and a button to report a payment

features.subhead: Six things the software does. Not adjectives - the actual actions your staff take and your tenants see.

portal.title: A portal tenants can read
portal.body: Every screen in English and Spanish, translated key by key. Not a translate widget bolted onto an English app.

queue.title: Every request in one queue
queue.body: Portal, WhatsApp, phone or walk-in - each work order records how it arrived, so nothing falls through whichever way the tenant reached you.

payments.title: Payments tenants can report
payments.body: Tenants pay by transfer, Zelle or check and report it with a photo. Staff compare the claim against the bank and confirm it.

maintenance.title: Maintenance with photos
maintenance.body: Requests carry images from the tenant's phone, get assigned to a vendor, and are tracked through to close.

compliance.title: Texas compliance built in
compliance.body: Late-fee limits, the deposit clock, the repair window and rekey deadlines are tracked against the dates the statute counts from.

cycle.title: The month's rent in one pass
cycle.body: Generate every invoice for the period, review the batch before it goes out, and send them together.

proof.subhead: Two of the screens they work in every day.
proof.disclaimer: Illustrative interface with demo data. Not a claim about results.

bilingual.headingLead: The leak gets reported while it is
bilingual.body: Both portals ship in English and Mexican Spanish - every screen, at exact parity, translated key by key rather than machine-translated at runtime.
bilingual.argument: This is not a courtesy feature. A tenant who cannot comfortably report a problem tends not to report it, and a small repair left alone stops being a small repair. Reading the request is the cheapest part of fixing it.
bilingual.parityLabel: translated strings, both portals, exact parity
bilingual.imageAlt: The same Rentio tenant portal screen side by side in English and Spanish

compliance.subhead: Rentio tracks these dates and warns you before they pass. It does not file anything for you.

lateFee.title: Late fees, held and capped
lateFee.body: The action stays disabled until rent is two full days late, and the amount is checked against the statutory cap.

deposit.title: The 30-day deposit clock
deposit.body: Starts when the forwarding address arrives, not at move-out, and tracks the itemised disposition against it.

repair.title: The seven-day repair window
repair.body: Conditions affecting health or safety carry a day counter from the tenant's written notice, amber before it lapses and red after.

rekey.title: Rekey within seven days
rekey.body: A new tenancy opens a turnover checklist with the rekey deadline counted from the day possession starts.

notice.title: Notice to vacate
notice.body: Generated as a PDF and recorded against the lease, with the date it was delivered.

compliance.disclaimer: Rentio helps you track statutory deadlines. It is not legal advice, and it does not guarantee compliance.

cta.body: A walkthrough on your own units and your own tenants - what the month looks like, what your tenants would see, and where the statutory clocks would already be running.
cta.note: Thirty minutes, no slides. Pick a time that suits you.
